jobs.description:
Welder - Semi-Automatic - Lokeren 

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

For a family-run metal workshop specializing in the production of steel doors and windows, we are looking for a semi-automatic welder to join the team. The company is known for its high-quality finishes, attention to detail, and passion for interior design and architecture. Every project is tailor-made — from design to the finished product — with a strong focus on craftsmanship and precision.

Job description:
As a semi-automatic welder, you will help produce steel doors and windows for both interior and exterior applications. You will be responsible for very fine welding work and ensure that every piece meets the highest quality standards.

Your tasks:

• 
Performing fine welding work (semi-automatic)

• 
Filing, grinding, and assembling components

• 
Cleaning and smoothing weld seams

• 
Reading and interpreting technical drawings

• 
Delivering precise, high-quality work

PROFIEL

Profile:

• 
You have experience as a welder or are a motivated school leaver

• 
You can read and understand technical plans

• 
You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English

• 
You enjoy detailed, varied work during day shifts

AANBOD
What’s on offer:
You will join a growing company with a strong reputation in the steel and interior design sector. You’ll work in a modern workshop alongside colleagues who value craftsmanship and quality.

Geen specifieke studievereisten

jobs.description:
Deboning Department Employee | Fixed Morning Shift

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

Working in a cold environment is not an issue? Working in the pork meat sector is no problem?

The deboning department is looking for a motivated colleague with experience as a butcher, deboner or experience within the meat industry.

Dutch, English and Polish are spoken within the department. Candidates who master one of these three languages are eligible.

Fixed morning shift from 5:15 AM to 1:15 PM.

PROFIEL

• 
Experience as butcher, deboner or within the meat industry is a strong asset.

• 
Knowledge of at least one of the following languages: Dutch, English or Polish.

• 
Precise and efficient working approach.

• 
Physically capable of performing active and standing work.

• 
Availability for a fixed morning shift

AANBOD

• 
Quick start possible.

• 
Permanent option always available.

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

For a company in the meat industry Oudenaarde, we are looking for an All-round Technician.

Forklift drivers - 2 shifts - region Desselgem

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

Do you have experience as a forklift driver and a valid forklift certificate?

Are you willing to work in shifts and in a fast-paced production environment?

This internationally growing production company specializes in innovative solutions for the construction and interior sector and is known for its strong focus on quality and sustainability. They are currently looking for forklift drivers to join their team in Desselgem in a stable and modern working environment.

What will you do?

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Transporting goods within the warehouse
• Supplying materials to the production lines
• SCanning and checking incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse clean and organized

PROFIEL

• Forklift certificate
• Experience as a forklift driver
• Knowledge Dutch or English
• Willing to work in shifts

AANBOD

What do we offer?

• Attractive salary 
• Stable job in an international company
• Shift allowance (extra pay for shifts) 
• Modern and safe working environment 
• Opportunities for growth and long-term employment

The company is a leading player in waste management, specialising in the sorting, processing and recycling of various waste streams. It continuously invests in new technologies to efficiently separate recyclable materials within a circular economy.
Multiple sites are located across Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

What will you do as a Hooklift Truck Driver?
	
• Transport, collect and place roll-off containers at customer locations	
• Secure containers with cover nets or tarps to ensure safe transport	
• Alternate between driving and manual work on-site	
• Respond to customer questions in a friendly and professional manner

What are we looking for in a Driver C/CE with Hooklift Experience?
	
• Driving licence C or CE; only C but motivated to drive with a trailer? CE can be obtained internally	
• Experience as a driver is an advantage but not required	
• You are an early starter (between 4 a.m. and 6 a.m.)	
• You speak Dutch, English or French for safety instructions

Forklift driver - polyvalent job

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

For a company in the Waregem area, I am looking for a polyvalent forklift driver.

Tasks:

• Operating gasoline-powered forklifts.
• Performing tasks without a forklift, such as hosing down trucks and containers.
• Working around live chickens.

PROFIEL

• You have a lot of experience with a forklift.
• You are in possession of a valid forklift certificate.
• You are flexible in hours. You start at 5am, but end times varies.
• You want to work in the area of chickens
• We can count on you 
• You can speak sufficient English. French is a plus.

AANBOD

• A fun job
• An attractive salary package

jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer Polish - German - English
jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Representative, you will work Monday to Friday in rotating shifts between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.

• Answer phone calls and emails from customers and partners.

• Collect and verify information.

• Provide technical support and maintain contact with repair workshops.

• Keep customers and all involved parties informed in a timely manner.

• Follow up on agreements and ensure all information is correctly processed in the customer file.

• You speak and write Polish, German, and English fluently to assist our customers effectively.

• You are comfortable working with computer systems and can multitask.

• You have strong communication skills and can handle phone calls and emails professionally.

• You are solution-oriented and always strive to provide the best support to customers.

For our client in Beernem, we are looking for an experienced tiler.
 

You will join a young and dynamic team.
 

Be sure to apply if you are interested!
 

 
 

 

 
 

 
• You are a worker with several years of experience in tiling
 
• A driving licence is required!
 
• You speak fluent Dutch or English
 
• You have a VCA certificate or are willing to obtain one

The company is located in an area with no traffic jams

Jobomschrijving

What does the role involve?
	
• As an operator, you are responsible for the accurate execution of production processes.	
• You precisely measure materials.	
• You perform calculations and ensure everything runs according to plan.	
• You work in an environment where quality and precision are key.

Profile – What do we expect from you?
	
• Strong numerical skills and the ability to measure accurately.	
• Good spatial awareness.	
• Fluency in Dutch or very good proficiency in English.	
• Flexibility: you work in day shifts, but are willing to switch to a two-shift system during peak workload.	
• Careful and correct working method, with strong attention to detail.

For our client in Beernem, we are looking for an experienced tiler.
 

You will join a young and dynamic team.
 

Be sure to apply if you are interested!
 

 
 

 

 
 

 
• You are a worker with several years of experience in tiling
 
• A driving licence is required!
 
• You speak fluent Dutch or English
 
• You have a VCA certificate or are willing to obtain one

Company located in Roeselare

Jobomschrijving

You will be responsible for:
	
• Moving and dragging foam blocks	
• Manually feeding the machine	
• Picking up foam scraps from the floor	
• Keeping the workplace clean and organized	
• Working together with your colleague to ensure a smooth production process

	
• You speak Dutch or English.	
• You are physically strong and enjoy active work.	
• You can perform repetitive tasks accurately.	
• You enjoy working together with a colleague.	
• Experience is not required; motivation is more important.	
• You can work in a day shift, and when production volumes increase, you are willing to work in a 2-shift system.
